article.story: MISSOULA, Mont. -- — Andrew Holifield scored 18 points, and Lamar beat Montana 68-63 on Sunday. Holifield added eight rebounds for the Cardinals (3-1). Cody Pennebaker shot 5 of 8 from the field to finish with 11 points, while adding eight rebounds. Courtney Anderson Jr. and Money Williams led the way for the Grizzlies (4-3) with 15 points each. Brooklyn Hicks also put up nine points and six rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
